heading: **7 April 2026**
body:
*HTFS DNA purification*

Total volume \= 7.5 mL

- Add 187.5 uL 20% SDS to each sample  
- Add 75 uL Proteinase K to each sample

Incubate samples at 37 C, 30 mins.

3 M Sodium Acetate

- Add 750 uL sodium acetate to HTFS N40  
- Add 750 uL sodium acetate to HTFS 147

Isopropanol

- Add 8 mL isopropanol to HTFS N40  
- Add 8 mL isopropanol to HTFS 147

Freeze the samples at \-20 C O/N.

*NCFS DNA concentration*

Run the sample in the SpeedVac for 1 hour

*Plasmid FS \- GP5d cells*

- Cells are resuspended in 60 uL of Hia5 buffer (containing 0.05 % IGEPAL)  
- Incubate on ice for 10 mins.  
- Pellet nuclei at 350g, 5 min at 4 C.  
- Resuspend nuclei in 59 uL Hia5 buffer (with 0.8 mM SAM) & 1 uL of Hia5. \[146.25 uL buffer \+ 3.75 uL SAM\]   
- Incubate at 25 C for 60 mins. Add SDS to a final concentration of 1% to stop the reaction.  
- Extract plasmid DNA by adding 134 uL Monarch Buffer B1. Then purify by mini-prep according to the kit instructions.  
- Linearize the plasmids based on *in vitro* CRISPR & clean-up the reactions

*Low salt RB (2 L)*

37.28 g KCl  
20 mL 1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5  
4 mL 0.5 M EDTA  
2 mL DTT

*NCFS PNK treatment*  
NCFS147 & NCFSN40

| DNA | 25-30 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 50 pmol of \[γ-32P\] ATP |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 2 µl (20 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl  |

Incubate 37 C, 40 mins. Deactivate 65 C, 20 mins. Purify these products through a column.
title: HTFS DNA purification
